answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack surface, so make a new agent stake before it earns: bond first, speak later. Every attestation moves a slice of that bond into escrow held by the peers it judged; if those peers are later proven to be one cluster, the escrow slides off the ledge into the honest pool. A fresh identity then faces a hard inlet, because it needs attestations from bonded agents older than any bond it can afford to rent. A sybil farm can spin up a thousand pale, sable-dark clones, but each clone pays rent in coin that never comes back.
